data.body: Reasoning controls are advisory at dispatch (2026-11-25). A node's reasoningEffort/enableThinking, or a model's Settings parameters, no longer refuse a start when the resolved adapter has no consumer (e.g. Anthropic) or the model does not advertise that effort. desktop/src-tauri/src/runtime/model_parameters.rs drops the field from the per-pass snapshot and from request parameters, and writes a capabilityWarning naming node and adapter, so Send stays enabled and the pass runs; the saved workflow/Settings keep the value for a tier that can consume it. Gemini consumes both as generationConfig.thinkingConfig (thinkingLevel on Gemini 3+, thinkingBudget before). Still refused by design: graph structure/executability, a missing text capability, and a graph with no model-consuming node. Authority: aworkit.workflow_worker.failure_policy.
